events.description: Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is performing all new material tonight.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay has twelve new songs about Lily Buffay's suicide and one new song about a snowman.
Chandler Bing says Phoebe Buffay should open with the snowman song.
Monica Geller asks how Joey Tribbiani's attempt to get the Santa job went.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani did not get the job.
Ross Geller asks how Joey Tribbiani failed to get the Santa job.
Ross Geller says Joey Tribbiani was Santa last year.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani does not know why Joey Tribbiani did not get the job.
Joey Tribbiani says Man 1 is sleeping with Man 2, the store manager.
Joey Tribbiani says Man 1 is not jolly.
Joey Tribbiani says the hiring decision for the Santa job is all political.
Monica Geller asks what position Joey Tribbiani is going to be at the store.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani is going to be one of Man 1's helpers, which Joey Tribbiani feels is a slap in the face.
Joey Tribbiani says Monica Geller knows what Joey Tribbiani means.
Rachel Green asks Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing what they are doing for New Year's.
Rachel Green asks what is wrong with New Year's.
Chandler Bing says Rachel Green has Paolo.
Chandler Bing says Rachel Green does not have to face the New Year's pressure of scrambling to find someone to kiss when the ball drops.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is talking loudly.
Rachel Green says Paolo will be in Rome on New Year's.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green will be just as pathetic as Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing on New Year's.
Phoebe Buffay says Rachel Green wishes Rachel Green would be just as pathetic as the rest of the group on New Year's.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is sick of being a victim of the Dick Clark New Year's holiday.
Chandler Bing says that this year the six friends should make a pact to have no dates and to have dinner together.
Chandler Bing says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Monica Geller know what Chandler Bing means.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing was hoping for a little more enthusiasm from the group.
Rachel Green says Phoebe Buffay is up to perform now.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay wants to start with a song that means a lot to Phoebe Buffay at this time of year.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay made a snowman with eyes of coal and a bewitching smile.
Phoebe Buffay says Lily Buffay was dead in the kitchen and Phoebe Buffay did not know.
Phoebe Buffay says Lily Buffay's ashes and eyelashes are resting in a little yellow jar.
Phoebe Buffay says the weather is sometimes breezy.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay feels a little sneezy when it is breezy.
Phoebe Buffay tells Max and David to excuse Phoebe Buffay.
Phoebe Buffay asks Max and David if Max and David would like to share their conversation with the entire group.
Max says declining to share with the entire group is okay.

Phoebe Buffay says that if Max and David think their conversation is important enough to discuss while Phoebe Buffay is playing, then Phoebe Buffay assumes it is important enough for everyone else to hear.
Chandler Bing says Max is going home with a note.
David says David was just saying something to Max.
Phoebe Buffay asks David to speak up.
David says David told Max that David thinks Phoebe Buffay is the most beautiful woman David has ever seen.
David says Max said that Max thinks Daryl Hannah is the most beautiful woman Max has ever seen.
David says Max considers Daryl Hannah the most beautiful woman Max has ever seen.
David says David agreed with Max by saying yes.
David says David liked Daryl Hannah in Splash.
David says David did not like Daryl Hannah in Wall Street.
David says David thought Daryl Hannah had a hard quality.
David says Daryl Hannah is beautiful in a conventional way.
David says Phoebe Buffay is luminous with a delicate grace.
David says Phoebe Buffay started yelling then.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay and the group are going to take a short break.
Joey Tribbiani says David is going home with more than a note.
